name: usage-topbar
description: A local Codex plugin with a native macOS overlay for rate limits, Codex connectivity, and live throughput.

interface.shortDescription: Show Codex usage, connectivity, and throughput.
interface.longDescription: Usage Topbar adds a SwiftUI liquid-glass edge tab that attaches above the Codex window's traffic-light controls and shows Codex rate-limit progress, Codex connectivity, live upload/download speed, reset timing, and points without covering the window.
defaultPrompt: Show a demo of the usage topbar.
Check whether the usage topbar is running.
